info.title: NYALES WEB-066 regional performance and coverage API
info.description: Local implementation. Mapping current at read cutoff; historical facts unchanged. Active canonical coverage cohort; invoice attribution remains historical and inaccessible current geography uses unmapped bucket. Definition nyales-geo-kpi-1; Customer scope read in keyset pages of 1000 without total truncation; bounds 50000 invoices/10000 activities/2000 targets. Not market share or provider-completeness evidence.
